items.item_text: Develop and implement strategic communications plans supporting the Freight Community, Action Coalition's education, engagement, and policy initiatives.
Manage and grow coalition social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
Create compelling content including videography, photography, social media posts, media advisories, and educational materials.
Develop messaging and public education campaigns focused on AB 98 truck route implementation, air quality, land-use planning, and environmental justice.
Coordinate digital organizing efforts to mobilize residents, community leaders, advocates, and coalition partners to participate in public hearings, workshops, and community actions
Produce and edit video content highlighting community impacts, coalition victories, public policy developments, and grassroots advocacy efforts.
Collaborate with coalition partners, environmental justice organizations, and community stakeholders to coordinate messaging and strengthen public engagement.
Join monthly Pitzer Brand Champions meetings (Last Thursday of each month)
Maintain coalition branding, messaging consistency, and digital presence across all
communications platforms.
Demonstrated experience in communications, digital media, advocacy campaigns, public affairs, social media management, and/or community engagement.
Editing, storytelling, and strategic messaging skills.
Experience creating communications materials for public education initiatives, and community organizing efforts.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong interpersonal skills and experience working with coalitions, community organizations, public agencies, and advocacy groups.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, social media analytics tools, and digital communications platforms.
Bilingual English and Spanish communication skills preferred.
Commitment to environmental justice, community empowerment, public health, and equitable land-use policies.
Proficiency in videography, photography, video editing, and digital media production.
Strong leadership and collaboration skills with a commitment to a team-based work environment.
Natural aptitude for technology and expertise with MS Office, including expert level use of Excel.
Ability to problem-solve and use analytical skills to develop and implement creative solutions.
Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
Ability to take initiative to work proactively, meet deadlines, organize and prioritize multiple projects, think strategically, and work with numbers and data.
Exhibit personal integrity and ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information.
Exhibit a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and sound professional judgment.
